title: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps | TechCrunch
summary: Google is making it easier for businesses to connect their apps to its AI experiences across Search and Gemini with the debut of its Connected Apps Platform. These apps will now come to Google Search over the next few weeks.
